items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I'm forgetting, were you on the record that Benny made of Spike Hughes' arrangements, the British arranger? [INTERVIEWEE] No. I never recorded with Benny.

ctx.x: A couple of years, because after her was when I joined Benny Carter. About '33, '34, something like that.
I'm forgetting, were you on the record that Benny made of Spike Hughes' arrangements, the British arranger?
No. I never recorded with Benny.
